scope: Sixteen material literature propositions in the current introduction and related-work draft.

entries.claim_summary: Automation can weaken preparation for rare supervisory work.
entries.scope_note: Mechanism claim only; no universal failure claim.

entries.claim_summary: Some oversight rules assign review without establishing performance capacity.
entries.scope_note: Institutional design proposition, not a measured prevalence claim.

entries.claim_summary: The cited streams cover control, human factors, incident research, and assurance.
Prior work covers reconstruction, intervention conditions, open-source classification, loss reconstruction, and prompt forensics.
entries.scope_note: Similarity statement bounded to named mechanisms.

entries.claim_summary: Signal-detection theory separates detection sensitivity from response tendency in oversight.
entries.scope_note: The manuscript states the paper's declared model at abstract level.

entries.claim_summary: Checklist evidence can fail to establish practical oversight performance.
entries.scope_note: Context sensitivity and testing burden remain visible.

entries.locator: Lam et al. formalize assurance audits
entries.claim_summary: A structured assurance-audit framework exists for algorithmic systems.
entries.scope_note: No claim that this repository originated assurance audits.

entries.locator: Gaube et al. supply a wider architecture
entries.claim_summary: A recent framework joins oversight definition, architecture, process, and documentation.
entries.scope_note: Preprint status and broad scope are retained.

entries.locator: Santoni de Sio and van den Hoven define
entries.claim_summary: Meaningful human control includes tracking and tracing conditions.
entries.scope_note: Philosophical account, not this paper's empirical result.

entries.claim_summary: Later work operationalizes control across ability, purpose, governance, teaming, and evaluative agency.
entries.scope_note: Sources supply distinct parts of the synthesis.

entries.claim_summary: Automation can transfer difficult fallback work to less-practiced operators.

entries.locator: Human response to algorithmic advice is conditional
entries.claim_summary: Human use of algorithmic advice varies and can include bias or selective adherence.

entries.locator: The AI Incident Database was created
entries.claim_summary: AIID supplies shared public incident infrastructure with variable records.

entries.locator: Macrae demonstrates that public investigative reports
entries.claim_summary: Public investigative reports can support sociotechnical incident analysis.
entries.scope_note: The cited works serve related but distinct evidence functions.

entries.claim_summary: Assurance structures claims, evidence, assumptions, and uncertainty.
entries.scope_note: The manuscript does not call the case packets safety cases.

entries.claim_summary: ScientistOne defines Chain-of-Evidence and four post-hoc integrity checks.
entries.scope_note: The repository claims an adaptation and no origination of those checks.

limits: The audit covers the current material literature sentences and no future manuscript revision.
Abstract-level review supports only claims within the source abstract.
Institutional database searching and complete backward and forward citation review remain open.
The audit supplies no novelty or systematic-review finding.
